items.title: What does Prefabo cost?
items.content: Prefabo is completely free for homebuyers. No fees, no catch. We're paid by our lender partners when you find your match—similar to how LendingTree and Bankrate work. You get access to lenders who specialize in prefab and modular homes without paying a dime for the introduction. Your lender's rates and terms are between you and them—we don't mark anything up or add broker fees. Our job is simply to connect you with the right financing partner for your situation.

items.title: What types of prefab homes do you finance?
items.content: We work with all types of modern prefab and modular construction—including panelized, modular, manufactured homes (post-1976), and container homes. Our lender network understands the full spectrum of factory-built housing.

items.title: Will applying affect my credit score?
items.content: No. Our initial rate estimates use a soft credit pull that doesn't impact your score. A hard pull only happens once you choose to move forward with a specific lender.

items.title: How do green mortgages work?
items.content: Homes with high energy efficiency ratings qualify for discounted rates from our eco-focused lending partners. We pull efficiency data directly from manufacturers to document your home's green credentials.

items.title: How long does approval take?
items.content: Average approvals take just 7 days—compared to the 45-60+ days typical with banks unfamiliar with prefab construction.

tabs.tab_content: Prefabo is completely free for homebuyers. No fees, no catch. We're paid by our lender partners when you find your match—similar to how LendingTree and Bankrate work. You get access to lenders who specialize in prefab and modular homes without paying a dime for the introduction. Your lender's rates and terms are between you and them—we don't mark anything up or add broker fees. Our job is simply to connect you with the right financing partner for your situation.

tabs.tab_title: What types of prefab homes do you finance?
tabs.tab_content: We work with all types of modern prefab and modular construction—including panelized, modular, manufactured homes (post-1976), and container homes. Our lender network understands the full spectrum of factory-built housing.

tabs.tab_title: Will applying affect my credit score?
tabs.tab_content: No. Our initial rate estimates use a soft credit pull that doesn't impact your score. A hard pull only happens once you choose to move forward with a specific lender.

Homes with high energy efficiency ratings qualify for discounted rates from our eco-focused lending partners. We pull efficiency data directly from manufacturers to document your home's green credentials.
Average approvals take just 7 days—compared to the 45-60+ days typical with banks unfamiliar with prefab construction.
